name: Amforge Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1971, Amforge Industries Ltd is a manufacturer of Steel Forgings[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
AIL, part of the Makar family, previously manufactured steel forgings for 2-wheeler crankshafts, connecting rods, bevel gears, bridge fork bottoms, etc., at its Chinchwad plant in Pune, serving the automotive industry. Currently, the company has no manufacturing operations.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.94 times its book value
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -21.1% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 0.71% over last 3 years.
Company's cost of borrowing seems high
